_readme: Every dataset behind the Fundability Map. The site's Data and sources view and DATA_SOURCES.md are built from this list. status: 'score' (drives the score or chance of an award), 'context' (shown, not scored), 'reference' (rules or model inputs), 'tested' (evaluated, not used), 'planned', 'service' (map and search).

sources.name: SiteLine StartUp pack (location scoring and its data)
sources.used_for: The location score: QAP §XI–§XXII points at every 0.25-mile grid point in the 11 ARC counties, used exactly as provided
sources.terms: No license file yet; provided to the team for this project
includes: USDA SNAP authorized retailers (groceries, big-box stores)
School attendance zones with DCA's CCRPI-based quality tests
Transit agency GTFS feeds (MARTA, CobbLinc, Ride Gwinnett, and others)
EPA Toxics Release Inventory and Georgia EPD hazardous sites
DCA stable-communities tract indicators and HUD CHAS
HUD LIHTC database and DCA award lists (previous projects)
National Register of Historic Places districts (NPS)
Census tracts and places; USDA food desert flags

sources.name: Georgia DCA 9% applicant and award lists, 2013–2025
sources.used_for: Past applications and outcomes: the weighting backtest, metric audit, win-probability model, and funding lines
sources.access: Public web page, one spreadsheet per round (contact details dropped on parsing)

sources.name: Georgia 2024–2025 Qualified Allocation Plan (QAP)
sources.used_for: The scoring rules: the rubric in the site's Methodology menu and the point values in the deal checklist
sources.vintage: Approved November 2023; governs the 2024 and 2025 rounds

sources.name: HUD Qualified Census Tracts, 2025 and 2026
sources.publisher: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development
sources.used_for: Basis boost (context) and the QCT point under §XIV

sources.name: HUD Small Area Difficult Development Areas, 2026
sources.publisher: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development

sources.name: HUD Low-Income Housing Tax Credit database
sources.publisher: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development
sources.used_for: Existing LIHTC units (saturation context) and award history for the backtest

sources.name: Census American Community Survey 5-year, 2020–2024 (tables B25002, B25003)
sources.access: Bulk table files (no API key needed)

sources.name: FEMA National Flood Hazard Layer
sources.used_for: Flood-zone warning at the exact looked-up spot (queried live)

sources.name: FEMA National Risk Index, census tracts
HUD CHAS tract tables, 2018–2022
sources.publisher: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development
sources.used_for: Renter households by income, for the planned market capture-rate check

sources.name: City of Atlanta Tax Allocation Districts
sources.publisher: City of Atlanta, via Atlanta BeltLine GIS
sources.used_for: Tested as a stand-in for §XIV revitalization plan areas; showed no signal, so not used

sources.name: OpenStreetMap tiles and Nominatim address search
sources.access: tile.openstreetmap.org and nominatim.openstreetmap.org (no key; light use)
